verdict.rationale: Better Auth provides standard OAuth/OIDC flows through built-in plugins rather than hand-rolled protocol code. These include social OAuth providers (Google, GitHub, Apple, Discord), an SSO plugin supporting OIDC, OAuth2 and SAML 2.0, an MCP plugin that acts as an OAuth authorization server, and an RFC 8628 device authorization grant plugin. Community users report OAuth sign-in options "just work" without special code. Missing for 10: no explicit evidence of authorization code with PKCE, refresh token issuance or rotation, or independent hands-on corroboration of those specific flows.
